findings.title: Pod can reach Secret: database-secret
findings.description: The modeled graph contains a directed path from Pod 'backend-pod' to Secret 'database-secret', ending with a CAN_ACCESS edge from 'backend-cluster-admin'. This indicates modeled Secret access according to the collected cluster relationships and RBAC rules.

scoreFactors.name: SECRET_SENSITIVITY
scoreFactors.reason: Estimated Secret sensitivity based on its type, name, labels, and namespace.

scoreFactors.name: PERMISSION_SCOPE
scoreFactors.reason: The access edge originates from a ClusterRoleBinding, which grants permissions cluster-wide to the referenced ClusterRole's rules.

scoreFactors.name: WILDCARD_PERMISSION
scoreFactors.reason: At least one RBAC rule grants wildcard apiGroups (*), resources (*), and verbs (*), giving unrestricted access.

scoreFactors.name: ATTACK_PATH_LENGTH
scoreFactors.reason: The modeled path contains 3 edge(s). Shorter paths indicate more direct access.

findings.recommendation: Review the ClusterRoleBinding's subjects and referenced ClusterRole. Remove unnecessary Secret permissions and restrict access to the required subjects.
